capabilities: Export a note as a .pptx file
Turn headings into slides and empty headings into section slides
Convert lists, tables, images, quotes and code blocks into native PowerPoint objects
Write note: paragraphs into speaker notes
Design a deck from EditablePPT templates with AI (optional)
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory, so it must be installed by hand from a release. Export is free and offline; only AI design uses the network and costs credits. Tested on desktop only.
problem: Notes cannot become presentation decks without rebuilding their content by hand in PowerPoint.

relations.evidence: It sends the note to EditablePPT, the service that maintains this plugin
one slide per separator, like the core Slides plugin

summary: Exports a note as an editable PowerPoint file, turning headings into slides with real text boxes, native tables and embedded images.
